## What the check establishes

CI checks that every listed name exists and that every reachable project dependency of the headline's type belongs to this fixed list after parent attribution. The closure is computed independently of the allowlist. The paired controls reject an untrusted construction-based statement, a required name removed from the list, altered routing contracts, and handwritten helpers with compiler-looking suffixes and literal-only bodies. Source-range attribution is tested both in the current module and across an actual compiled/imported module.

The theorem proofs are machine-checked. Mathematical semantic review therefore focuses on the listed definitions and the headline statement. This does not claim that the checker or Lean's implementation is formally verified here, nor that formal model fidelity experimentally validates a device.

## Verification trust

- [Axiom audit](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/Audit.lean): only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` are permitted.
- [Lean toolchain](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/lean-toolchain) and [dependency commits](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/lake-manifest.json): the compiler, kernel, Mathlib and library implementation are verification dependencies.
- [Dependency traversal](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/KernelR/TrustedBaseChecker.lean) and [explicit allowlist/check invocation](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/KernelR/TrustedBase.lean): definitions are followed, proofs are not unfolded, and imported library internals are leaves.
- [Generated declaration manifest](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/evidence/trusted_base.json): names, generated source ranges and authenticated source hashes.
- [CI build action](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/.github/actions/build-lean/action.yml): verifies the pinned Lean distribution and builds the Lake package.
- [Fresh Lean export](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/scripts/evidence/export_trusted_base.py), [source boundary](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/proof/lean/scripts/check_trusted_source_boundary.py), and [CI workflow](https://github.com/HevisNico/kernel-R/blob/43106cb00f707989d589c28aa5529586088c4202/.github/workflows/lean.yml): the exported list is rechecked, existing Lean declarations are preserved, and the controls run at the recorded revision.

Full CI status and validation counts must be read at their exact recorded commit. The generated declaration list is not itself a claim that a CI run passed.
